execution_notes: Use the supplied edit mask only; do not expand edits beyond it.
Favor structural inpainting / local geometry edit over generative redesign.
Maintain exact global grading and illumination continuity with the untouched room.
If the model cannot reliably preserve the official mask identity in tiny visible fragments, bias toward showing less of the figure rather than inventing new facial structure.
provider_requirements.routing_hint: Prefer the model with strongest masked inpainting and hard preservation outside selection.

risk_flags: Geometric door swing may tempt the model to alter frame width or perspective inside the mask.
Tiny slit visibility may cause the model to hallucinate a new face instead of preserving the existing mask identity.
The requested 18–25 px slit is very narrow; some models may over-hide all features or reveal too much.
Because no source identity reference JSON is provided, preservation relies entirely on the source image and prompt discipline.
